title: The Doctor Who Injected Athletes with Liquid Mercury for Speed
hook: A physician believed mercury could rewire nerves to shorten reaction times, and his patients were the fastest men in the world — until their teeth fell out.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mercury as a performance enhancer is shocking and visually grotesque — viewers will share it for the sheer horror factor.

title: The Coach Who Made Gymnasts Train on Broken Springs to Build 'Fearlessness'
